overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（2 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以机器学习、调查数据为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（7 篇）、arXiv（4 篇）、Semantic Scholar（1 篇）。

papers.title: Machine Learning Prediction of Transport Properties in Amorphous Polymer Electrolytes Using Chemically Informed Structural Descriptors
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Amorphous polymer electrolytes are promising candidates for next-generation lithium batteries. They offer improved safety and mechanical stability compared to conventional liquid electrolytes. However, predicting their transport performance remains challenging. Ionic conductivity and diffusivity depend on complex, coupled interactions between polymer structure, chemistry, and ion dynamics. This work leverages machine learning to predict four key transport properties in amorphous polymer electrolytes using a molecular dynamics data set of more than 6,000 polymer electrolyte systems. These are ionic conductivity, bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (TFSI) diffusivity, lithium-ion diffusivity, and polymer diffusivity. To enhance predictive capability and preserve mechanistic interpretability, we engineered chemically and structurally meaningful features from Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System (SMILES) representations. Selected features include elemental composition, functional group densities, polarity descriptors, and polymer flexibility metrics. Three modeling frameworks were trained and evaluated under 5-fold cross-validation, including random forest, gradient boosting, and neural networks. The neural network achieved the highest predictive performance across all four targets and exceeded prior benchmarks on three of them. It also exhibited substantially greater robustness to data partitioning than the tree-based baselines. Feature importance analysis was performed using both impurity-based rankings and Shapley additive explanations. Polymer backbone flexibility, polarity, and ionic environment were found to dominate transport behavior. Directional attribution further identified primary and secondary amines and carboxylate groups as specific negative contributors to lithium-ion mobility. The results of this work demonstrate that chemically informed structural descriptors can effectively predict electrolyte performance while yielding mechanistic insight. This enables accelerated screening and design of high-efficiency polymer electrolytes for future energy storage applications.

papers.title: Exploring sustainable telework productivity: a framework for adapting to socio-political instability
papers.venue: International Journal of Productivity and Performance Management
papers.abstract:
Purpose
                    Amid accelerating technological change, the expansion of e-governance and growing socio-political instability, organizations increasingly depend on telework. This study identifies the key factors that shape effective and sustainable telework productivity in disruptive contexts, with a specific focus on Iran.
                  
                  
                    Design/methodology/approach
                    The research employed a systematic literature review combined with a structured survey. Using equation structural modeling (ESM), the study analyzed causal-hierarchical relationships between productivity indicators by focusing on Iran a country experiencing persistent political, economic and social turbulence. Within this fragile context, the electric sector was selected due to its importance and high vulnerability to disruption. Data were collected from 64 managers using a census sampling technique.
                  
                  
                    Findings
                    The most influential drivers of sustainable telework productivity were identified as: (1) productive occupational attitudes, (2) hierarchical support and (3) provision of resources and infrastructure. In contrast, “telework performance management” emerged as the most impacted yet least influential factor in the model. In the ESM-based hierarchical model, each level's factors exert influence on the levels above while simultaneously being affected by the levels below, reflecting the interdependent structure of the system.
                  
                  
                    Originality/value
                    This study introduces a unified theoretical framework for productive telework in unstable environments. The research contributes to the performance management literature by demonstrating that telework productivity is shaped not only by infrastructure and managerial mechanisms but also by broader social and organizational dynamics. The study further extends telework scholarship by incorporating contextual considerations related to gender roles, work–family balance and sustainability concerns. It offers a practical tool for managers, executives, and scholars aiming to enhance telework effectiveness. By focusing on the identified indicators, organizational leaders can define strategic priorities to improve productivity outcomes and build more sustainable remote work systems. While the empirical case focuses on Iran's electricity sector, the identified factors reflect generic organizational dimensions that can be conceptually applied in other contexts facing comparable disruptions.

papers.title: Multichoice Modeling: Exploring Decision Configuration Space under Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Decision support has become sophisticated at exploring uncertainty, but much less so at representing the architecture of the decision itself. As a result, the decision space is often narrowed before uncertainty is analyzed, leaving interactions among choices and the effects of alternatives they imply largely invisible. This paper introduces multichoice modeling, a framework for making large decision configuration spaces explicit and computationally explorable under uncertainty. Drawing on the logic of rugged landscapes, we conceptualize such problems as contingent performance landscapes, where interdependent choices generate configuration-specific outcomes whose value changes across uncertain futures. The computational framework combines multidimensional decision and uncertainty spaces in a single simulation. Further, variance-based sensitivity analysis is used for identifying influential choices, and conditional distribution analysis for comparing configuration-specific performance profiles. We demonstrate the framework through three case studies: a manufacturing process upgrade, M&A strategy, and mortgage design. By contrasting conventional uncertainty-only analysis with multichoice modeling, the cases show how opening the decision configuration space can reveal unexpected complementarities, near-best configurations with different risk profiles, and strategies that were not apparent as alternatives at the outset.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】决策支持在应对不确定性方面已经取得了显著进展，但在描述决策本身的结构方面却相对薄弱。因此，在对不确定性进行分析之前，决策空间往往就被人为缩小了，导致各种选择之间的相互作用及其潜在影响被忽视。本文提出了多选项建模（multichoice modeling）这一框架，旨在在不确定性条件下明确表示复杂的决策配置空间，并使其能够被计算机有效处理。借鉴“崎岖景观”（rugged landscapes）的逻辑概念，我们将这类问题视为“条件性绩效景观”（contingent performance landscapes）：相互依赖的选择会生成特定于某种配置的结果，而这些结果的价值会随着不确定的未来情境而变化。该计算框架将多维决策空间与不确定性空间整合到一个统一的模拟过程中。此外，我们采用基于方差的敏感性分析来识别关键决策因素，并通过条件分布分析来比较不同配置下的绩效表现。通过三个案例研究（制造流程升级、并购策略和抵押贷款设计）来验证这一框架的有效性。对比传统的仅关注不确定性的分析方法与多选项建模方法，这些案例表明：扩展决策配置空间能够揭示出意想不到的互补性、具有不同风险特性的近乎最优配置，以及...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Risk Sensitivity and Stationary Equilibrium in Incomplete Markets
papers.abstract: We study stationary equilibrium and comparative statics in an incomplete market economy with risk-sensitive preferences. We prove that a stationary equilibrium exists for every nonnegative degree of risk sensitivity. With independent income, greater risk sensitivity weakly raises aggregate saving at fixed prices and weakly lowers the smallest and the largest equilibrium interest rates. With stochastically monotone Markov income, these comparisons hold when the lower risk-sensitivity parameter is sufficiently small or the upper parameter sufficiently large. For pairs of intermediate values, however, greater risk sensitivity can lower saving, contrary to an existing result in the literature, and can raise the smallest and largest equilibrium rates. An exact decomposition identifies the forces driving these reversals.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了具有风险敏感偏好的不完全市场经济中的静态均衡与比较静态分析。我们证明了：对于任何非负的风险敏感度水平，都存在一个静态均衡。在收入独立的情况下，较高的风险敏感度会在价格固定的条件下略微增加总体储蓄，并略微降低最低和最高的均衡利率。在收入遵循随机单调马尔可夫过程的情况下，当较低的风险敏感度参数足够小或较高的参数足够大时，上述比较结果仍然成立。然而，对于中等风险敏感度水平，较高的风险敏感度反而可能降低储蓄，并提高最低和最高的均衡利率，这与现有文献中的结论相反。通过精确的分解，我们揭示了导致这些变化的具体机制。。研究方法：随机过程、均衡模型。

papers.title: Financial Flexibility and Profitability of Non-Financial Firms Listed at the Nairobi Securities Exchange, Kenya
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Finance and Accounting Studies
papers.abstract: Non-financial firms depicts positive and pivotal social economic contributions to the economy in terms of creation of employment, poverty reduction and growth and development of the country’s gross domestic product. However, the financial flexibility causal effect relationship with their profitability is still having controversial debate amongst scholars resulting to its direct effect on profitability being limited, particularly within African frontier capital markets. This study examined the effect of financial flexibility on the profitability of non-financial firms listed at the Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE), Kenya, for a time horizon between 2015–2024. The study adopted a longitudinal panel research design and utilized firm-level secondary data from 42 non-financial firms in Kenya. Profitability was gauged using Return on Assets (ROA), while financial flexibility was operationalized as firm cash ratio minus industry cash ratio plus the maximum of industry debt ratio minus firm debt ratio or zero. Panel econometric techniques were employed, with diagnostic tests for normality, multicollinearity, heteroscedasticity, serial correlation and stationarity conducted prior to estimation. The Chow and Hausman tests supported a fixed-effects specification with firm-clustered robust standard errors. The findings indicate that financial flexibility had a direct effect on profitability which was statistically significant. The study concluded that firms maintaining greater financial flexibility are better positioned to respond to financing requirements and investment opportunities, thereby enhancing profitability. The study recommends that managers of non-financial firms listed at the NSE preserve adequate financial flexibility through disciplined liquidity planning, diversified financing sources and maintenance of unused debt capacity. Policymakers and capital-market regulators should promote diversified financing alternatives and improved disclosure of financial risks to strengthen firm resilience and profitability.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】非金融企业在创造就业机会、减少贫困以及促进国家国内生产总值的增长和发展方面，对经济做出了积极且至关重要的贡献。然而，关于财务灵活性与企业盈利能力之间的因果关系，学者们仍存在争议，尤其是在非洲的新兴资本市场中，这种关系的直接影响仍不明确。本研究考察了2015年至2024年间，肯尼亚内罗毕证券交易所（NSE）上市的非金融企业的财务灵活性对其盈利能力的影响。研究采用了纵向面板研究设计，并使用了来自42家非金融企业的企业级二手数据。盈利能力通过资产回报率（ROA）来衡量，而财务灵活性则通过“企业现金比率减去行业现金比率再加上行业债务比率的最大值减去企业债务比率（或为零）”来定义。在估计之前，研究人员对数据进行了正态性、多重共线性、异方差性、序列相关性和平稳性的诊断性检验。Chow检验和Hausman检验支持采用固定效应模型，并采用了企业分组后的稳健标准误差。研究结果表明，财务灵活性对盈利能力具有显著的直接影响。研究认为，具备较高财务灵活性的企业更能适应融资需求和投资机会，从而提升盈利能力。研究建议在NSE上市的非金融企业管理者应通过规范的流动性规划、多元化的融资渠道以及保持未使用的债务能...。

papers.title: FINANCIAL PLANNING MEDIATES FINANCIAL LITERACY AND CAPITAL ACCESS IN ENTERPRISE INVESTMENT DECISIONS
papers.abstract: This study examines the influence of financial literacy and access to capital on investment decisions, with financial planning as a mediating variable among food and beverage Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in West Java, Indonesia. This research employed a quantitative approach using a descriptive and verificative design. Data were collected from 135 MSME owners selected through stratified random sampling using a Likert-scale questionnaire. The results indicate that financial literacy and access to capital have positive and significant effects on financial planning. Financial literacy and access to capital also have positive and significant direct effects on investment decisions. Furthermore, financial planning has a positive and significant effect on investment decisions and significantly mediates the relationship between financial literacy, access to capital, and investment decisions. The study highlights that improving MSME investment decisions requires strengthening financial literacy, expanding access to capital, and encouraging effective financial planning practices simultaneously. These factors contribute to better resource allocation and support the long-term sustainability of food and beverage MSMEs.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了金融素养和资本获取对投资决策的影响，其中财务规划作为中介变量，研究了印度尼西亚西爪哇省食品和饮料行业微型、小型及中型企业（MSMEs）的决策过程。研究采用定量方法，采用描述性和验证性研究设计。数据通过分层随机抽样方式从135位MSME所有者处收集，调查工具为李克特量表问卷。研究结果表明，金融素养和资本获取对财务规划具有积极且显著的影响；同时，这两者也对投资决策产生积极且显著的影响。此外，财务规划对投资决策具有积极且显著的作用，并在金融素养、资本获取与投资决策之间的关系中起到显著的中介作用。研究强调，要改善MSME的投资决策，需要同时提升金融素养、拓宽资本获取渠道并鼓励有效的财务规划实践。这些因素有助于优化资源配置，支持食品和饮料行业MSME的长期可持续发展。。

papers.title: E-commerce development and rural dietary quality in China: spatial spillovers and nonlinear associations
papers.venue: Journal of Agribusiness in Developing and Emerging Economies
papers.abstract:
Purpose
                    Rural e-commerce is expanding rapidly in China; yet, its implications for dietary quality remain insufficiently understood. Existing studies mainly rely on micro-level data, while systematic regional evidence is scarce because comparable dietary data at finer spatial scales are difficult to obtain. This study examines the association between provincial e-commerce development and rural dietary quality in China, quantifying spatial spillovers and identifying conditional variations across regions.
                  
                  
                    Design/methodology/approach
                    Using panel data for 31 provinces from 2015 to 2021, this study constructs a rural dietary quality distance (RDQD) index based on the Chinese Dietary Guidelines and the Diet Balance Index. Spatial Durbin models with alternative spatial weight matrices (contiguity, inverse distance and gravity) are employed to estimate local and spillover associations. Moderation and threshold models are further used to assess nonlinear roles of rural digital access, consumption level and income level, together with regional and post-COVID heterogeneity.
                  
                  
                    Findings
                    E-commerce development is associated with lower RDQD locally and, on average, with positive spillovers to neighboring provinces. These associations are highly uneven: improvements are strongest in western and non-grain-producing regions, whereas major grain-producing regions show worsening dietary quality. Digital access, consumption and income levels moderate the e-commerce–diet relationship in an inverted-U-shaped pattern, with marginal benefits attenuating beyond identified thresholds. Positive associations persist after COVID-19 but weaken over time.
                  
                  
                    Research limitations/implications
                    This study is based on provincial-level panel data and therefore captures average regional patterns rather than household-level behavioral mechanisms. The province-level approach is intended to complement, not replace, existing micro-level studies. In addition, the e-commerce indicator reflects overall transaction dynamics and does not isolate food-related or fresh-food e-commerce. Future research could combine finer spatial data, household surveys and more disaggregated e-commerce indicators to strengthen causal identification and improve understanding of the mechanisms linking digital market development to dietary quality.
                  
                  
                    Social implications
                    By improving access to diverse foods, e-commerce has the potential to support healthier diets in rural China, but its benefits are unevenly distributed. Regions with weak digital access, lower incomes or limited food distribution capacity may not benefit equally and can even experience worsening dietary outcomes. The study therefore highlights the importance of inclusive digital development so that rural households are not excluded from healthier food environments as online food purchasing becomes more widespread.
                  
                  
                    Originality/value
                    This study develops a province-level indicator of rural dietary quality and provides regional evidence on how rural e-commerce is associated with dietary quality through both local and spatial channels in China. It complements the existing micro-level literature by identifying broad spatial patterns, regional heterogeneity and nonlinear enabling conditions. The paper also adds value by linking digital market integration to diet quality within a large developing economy undergoing rapid rural digital transformation.

papers.title: BEYOND TECHNOSTRESS AI Fatigue as a Cumulative Adaptation Burden in Education and Work
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has become a persistent layer of work and learning rather than an occasional tool. Users must repeatedly decide when to delegate, how to prompt, whether to trust, how to verify, and how responsibility should be distributed. This integrative review defines AI fatigue as a cumulative reduction in the cognitive, affective, or motivational capacity for adaptive AI engagement when interaction, evaluation, correction, learning, and role-adjustment demands accumulate faster than recovery and support. The review connects technostress, automation vigilance, cognitive load and offloading, trust calibration, digital fatigue, and the Job Demands–Resources perspective. It introduces an Exposure–Adaptation–Depletion–Response framework, a five-domain taxonomy, and an AI Fatigue Load model that separates use volume from uncertainty, task stakes, correction burden, interruption, role disruption, and imposed adoption velocity. The analysis is updated to incorporate a 2026 validated 15-item AI Fatigue Scale; the proposed load model complements that psychophysiological outcome measure by specifying socio-technical antecedents and exposure conditions. Educational and organizational applications show why AI may simultaneously improve output and worsen human sustainability. The article identifies recurring inferential errors, presents a measurement and longitudinal research agenda, and proposes an intervention hierarchy spanning interface design, workflow, curriculum, organizational policy, and governance. AI fatigue is positioned neither as generic screen tiredness nor as a synonym for burnout, but as an adaptation problem located in the coupled human–AI–institution system.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能已不再是一种偶尔使用的工具，而成为人们持续面对的工作与学习方式。用户必须反复决策：何时将任务委托给人工智能、如何向它提供指导、是否信任其结果、如何验证其准确性，以及如何分配责任。本文将“AI疲劳”定义为一种综合性的心理状态，表现为在面对人工智能交互、评估、修正、学习及角色调整等需求时，个体的认知能力、情感状态或动机水平逐渐下降；这些需求的增长速度超过了个体通过恢复机制或获得支持的速度。研究将“技术压力”“自动化带来的警觉性”“认知负荷与负担的转移”“信任机制的调整”“数字疲劳”等概念与“工作需求-资源模型”（Job Demands–Resources model）联系起来，并提出了一种名为“暴露-适应-耗竭-反应”（Exposure–Adaptation–Depletion–Response）的分析框架，该框架包含五个维度，用于描述AI使用过程中可能产生的影响。同时，研究还构建了一个AI疲劳负荷模型，该模型将使用频率与任务的不确定性、任务的重要性、修正工作的负担、干扰因素、角色冲突以及强制性的采用速度等因素区分开来。分析结果基于2026年修订后的15项AI疲劳量表（AI ...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Carbon price distortion and energy resource misallocation: evidence from China’s emissions trading scheme
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  The Coase Theorem suggests that carbon markets should primarily perform two functions: price discovery and resource allocation. However, carbon price distortions may weaken both functions, raising concerns over resource misallocation and a possible “distortion superposition” effect. This study constructs a generalized cost function incorporating factor price distortions and carbon emission constraints to measure the degree of carbon price distortion. Using panel data for 30 Chinese provinces from 2000 to 2022 and a difference-in-differences approach, we examine how carbon price distortion affects energy resource misallocation in emissions trading scheme (ETS) pilot regions. The results show that energy misallocation is widespread across provinces and exhibits substantial regional heterogeneity. More importantly, the implementation of the ETS significantly aggravates energy misallocation in pilot areas, indicating that the policy, at its current stage, has not effectively directed energy resources toward high-efficiency and low-carbon sectors. Carbon price distortion further amplifies this adverse effect: the larger the deviation of carbon prices from their reasonable level, the stronger the ETS-induced deterioration in energy allocation. Mechanism analysis shows that carbon price distortion exacerbates energy misallocation mainly by constraining energy input and inhibiting green innovation. These findings provide empirical support for improving allowance allocation, refining carbon price formation, thereby contributing to the optimization of energy resource allocation and the achievement of China’s “dual-carbon” goals.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】摘要  
科斯定理指出，碳市场应主要承担两项职能：价格发现与资源配置。然而，碳价格扭曲可能会削弱这两种职能，引发对资源错配以及潜在的“扭曲叠加”效应的担忧。本研究构建了一个包含要素价格扭曲和碳排放约束的广义成本函数，用以衡量碳价格扭曲的程度。利用2000至2022年间中国30个省份的面板数据，并采用差分法（difference-in-differences approach），我们分析了碳价格扭曲对碳排放交易体系（ETS）试点地区能源资源错配的影响。研究结果表明，能源资源错配现象在各省普遍存在，且存在显著的地区差异。更为重要的是，ETS的实施加剧了试点地区的能源资源错配问题，表明该政策在当前阶段尚未有效引导能源资源向高效、低碳领域流动。碳价格扭曲进一步放大了这一负面效应：碳价格偏离合理水平的程度越大，ETS对能源资源配置的负面影响就越明显。机制分析表明，碳价格扭曲主要通过限制能源投入和抑制绿色创新来加剧能源资源错配。这些发现为改进配额分配、优化碳价格形成提供了实证支持，从而有助于优化能源资源配置并实现中国的“双碳”目标。。研究方法：双重差分、面板数据、优化方法。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Pregnancy, Childbirth, and the Postpartum Period: A Scoping Review
authors: ANNA PAULA MENDES MARQUES DE LIMA FRANCO
papers.abstract: Background: The use of digital health technologies, such as chatbots and virtual assistants based on artificial intelligence, has grown significantly in maternal health. These tools have been applied at different stages of the pregnancy and postpartum cycle, with emphasis on health education, risk monitoring, breastfeeding support, and mental healthcare. Despite their potential, challenges remain regarding clinical effectiveness, equity of access, and ethical safety. The aim of this study was to map the available evidence regarding the applications of artificial intelligence in pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum care, with particular emphasis on conversational agents, virtual assistants, machine learning models, and clinical decision support systems, as well as their potential benefits, limitations, ethical implications, and implementation challenges. Methods: A scoping review was conducted between August and September 2025 in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Nursing Database, Latin American and Caribbean Literature in Health Sciences, and Google Scholar. Original articles, reviews, experience reports, and theoretical reflections published in Portuguese, English, or Spanish that addressed the use of digital tools based on artificial intelligence in the pregnancy and postpartum cycle were included. The analysis of the studies was organized into five thematic axes: applications in prenatal care; support during childbirth; postpartum monitoring and breastfeeding; perinatal mental health; and ethical, technical, and implementation challenges. Results: The search identified 6230 records, of which 13 studies were included. Findings indicate that chatbots and virtual assistants show good acceptability, promote health education, and contribute to the early detection of physical and emotional risks. However, most of the studies are exploratory, with methodological limitations, lack of clinical trials, and limited validation in socially vulnerable contexts. Conclusions: Chatbots and artificial intelligence tools are promising resources for perinatal care, particularly as a complement to face-to-face attention. Their consolidation requires robust studies, cost-effectiveness assessments, and public policies that ensure equity and digital inclusion.

papers.title: Equilibria and Learning in Competitive Market Making
papers.abstract: We propose a market-making game played among $N \ge 2$ strategic market makers and a single non-strategic representative trader. In a continuous quote space, standard finite-game arguments do not apply, while non-convex and discontinuous payoffs rule out classical continuous existence results and complicate learning. Nonetheless, we characterize pure-strategy Nash equilibria (PSNEs) and show that at least one PSNE always exists under minimal assumptions on the underlying asset value distribution, and that the equilibrium bid-ask spread widens strictly with asset value volatility. To obtain a tractable learning framework, we discretize prices and, under an additional regularity condition, show that the time-averaged play of no-internal-regret learners approaches the continuous Nash price envelope as the tick size vanishes. Finally, we empirically validate our theoretical results through numerical simulations.

papers.title: The Reaction of Financial Markets to the Releases of DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K3: A Critical Analysis
papers.abstract: This paper compares financial-market reactions to the releases of DeepSeek R1 in January 2025 and Kimi K3 in July 2026. Both AI models were presented as credible Chinese competitors near the capability frontier, but their releases conveyed different economic information. DeepSeek R1 combined open weights with unusually low reported training and inference costs, prompting investors to reassess expected demand for computing infrastructure and producing large stock-price decreases among semiconductor and data-centre-related firms. Kimi K3 instead entered at broadly frontier prices and generated a market reaction concentrated more heavily among rival Chinese AI laboratories. Drawing on descriptive event-window evidence, model capability and cost comparisons, subsequent industry developments, and the historical diffusion of open-source software, the paper argues that open-weight models redistribute rents across the AI value chain rather than eliminating them. Incumbents remain protected by complementary assets including distribution, product bundling, switching costs, proprietary data, serving capacity, and contractual trust. The analysis suggests that investors and policy makers should assess risks looking not only at model capability, but also at the ownership and durability of complementary assets across the AI value chain.
